textDetails.positiveText: The balcony view over the lagoon at sunrise was unforgettable and the staff arranged a late checkout without any fuss.
textDetails.negativeText: The air conditioning was a little noisy at night.

textDetails.positiveText: Waking up in the garden bungalow surrounded by palms felt like a private hideaway, and the outdoor shower was lovely.
textDetails.negativeText: The path to the bungalow was dimly lit after dark.

textDetails.positiveText: Great value studio, the kitchenette meant we could cook simple meals and the partial water view was a nice bonus.
textDetails.negativeText: The studio was a bit small for two large suitcases.

textDetails.positiveText: Perfect for a work trip: the wifi was fast, the desk was spacious, and the rain shower woke me up every morning.
textDetails.negativeText: Breakfast options were limited for early risers.

textDetails.positiveText: The blackout curtains and quiet street-facing room gave me the best sleep I have had while travelling for business.
textDetails.negativeText: The lobby can get busy at check-in time.
